entry_state: Capital and allowance measures reconcile without supplying liquidity or payout permission. Asset classification requires contractual cash-flow and business-model findings before the loan method is chosen. ECL uses dated, probability-weighted discounted cash shortfalls; a twelve-month horizon selects default events rather than truncating later losses. The commitment example conditions on actual draw while preserving its original credit baseline and supported lifetime horizon; its remaining alternatives continue next.
exit_state: The commitment lapse and funded alternatives preserve distinct exposures. The ordinary loan separates accrual, credit deterioration, collection and write-off; POCI instead embeds initial losses in its credit-adjusted rate and recognises subsequent signed changes. Dated receipts and partial write-offs preserve financial and legal claim histories separately. Fractional periods and an irrational original rate require propagated enclosures; the rate-bracket example continues with its dated financial path.
findings: The ordinary loan retains negative equity instead of inventing support; discount unwind is not charged again as impairment.
The purchased impaired claim can have a negative subsequent-change allowance representing a favorable asset adjustment.
An identified partial write-off is distinguished from a lower recovery forecast and from legal forgiveness.
Integer-power bounds and present-value monotonicity justify numerical enclosures, not exact rounded rates or economic probabilities. No new confirmed defect.
